main_text.head: Admonitio.
main_text.p: Patrum Tridentinorum auderet illas Synodos legitimis accenfere ; aut Felicem pro vero Papa agnofcere, fed & ab Eugenii potiffimum authoritate & fui Concilii Florentini astruCretur Papæ Monarchia univerfalis, ut decreta est in literis Unionis: ut jam, si quoquam argumento probare vellem, sola Papæ authoritate constare authoritatem Conciliorum, Ecclefiæ & doctrinarum Romanensium, id mihi assumerem, quod Vir reverendus protulit ut contrarium astrueret.

Quod dicit non magis Transsubstantiationi Papistarum quam consubstantiationi Lutheranorum accedere authoritatem ab imperio aliquo pompâ, robore & divitiis illustri, non multum habet virium, nego enim parem esse

page.notes: Text is in roman with italic heading; the printed word is "astrueretur" in the first paragraph, rendered here as printed in the scan's first line; a few words in the scan are blurred by show-through and stains. Possibly doubtful: "astruePretur" (line 6) and "pompâ," (line 3 of the second paragraph) read as printed.
